{{Quote|Sure! You see the starport over there? The Imperial communications tower? Trandoshan's can now trod freely all around the city. It is a shame to see my world fallen so low.|[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RotW" />}}
The '''Kachirho Starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], on the world [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />
